designationHistory.name: Bone Hill Creek Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Executive Order 8112 setting apart 640 acres in LaMoure County, North Dakota, as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds.
designationHistory.note: Both sources carry the same order text (APP transcribes the Federal Register); no FWS document with the date was found. Renamed Bone Hill National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416 (July 25, 1940).

sources.name: The American Presidency Project (UC Santa Barbara), Executive Order 8112
